data.one_liner: Renders AI-generated A2UI surfaces as Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: A2UI Flutter parses JSON-based UI messages generated by AI agents and renders them as standard Flutter widgets. It includes the basic catalog of components like lists, buttons, text, and inputs to quickly construct dynamically generated user interfaces.
use_when: You are building an app driven by an AI agent that dynamically designs user interfaces.
You want to render A2UI protocol v1.0 or v0.9 surfaces inside a Flutter app.
avoid_when: You are building a standard application with a pre-designed, static UI structure.
You do not use an A2UI-compliant backend or agent.
strengths: Provides built-in basic component catalog using Material widgets.
Supports dynamic data bindings and reactivity out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires careful security handling when working with untrusted AI agents.
Network images and media on macOS require specific entitlements.
data.setup_notes: Add a2ui_flutter and a2ui_core to pubspec.yaml. On macOS, network images and media need the com.apple.security.network.client entitlement.
